en: Your son returns from a visit home more attached to his relatives.
ph_ar: ولدي رجع من البلاد متعلق بأولاد عمو
ph_en: My son came back from the trip home really attached to his cousins

en: Your family back home moves to a new house you have never lived in.
ph_ar: أهلي بدلوا الدار وأنا عمري ما سكنت فيها
ph_en: My family moved to a new house back home that I've never lived in

en: You hear news from your homeland and worry about your family all day.
ph_ar: الأخبار متاع بلادي تقلقني على أهلي
ph_en: The news from back home has me worried about my family all day

en: You think about buying a house back home though your return date is unclear.
ph_ar: نفكر نشري دار في البلاد وما نعرفش وقتاش نرجع
ph_en: I'm thinking of buying a house back home but don't know when I'll return

en: The idea of returning comforts you but its practical details overwhelm you.
ph_ar: فكرة الرجوع تريحني بس التفاصيل تخوفني
ph_en: Moving back appeals to me but the practical side overwhelms me

en: You settle back home and struggle to readapt.
ph_ar: رجعت نستقر في البلاد وما تأقلمتش
ph_en: I moved back home and I'm struggling to readjust

en: Your children miss the country you used to live in after the family returns.
ph_ar: ولادي توحشوا البلاد اللي كنا فيها
ph_en: My kids miss the country we used to live in

en: You learn to keep a close bond with your family despite the time difference.
ph_ar: نحاول نبقى قريب من أهلي رغم فرق التوقيت
ph_en: I'm learning to stay close to family despite the time difference

en: You start a weekly family tradition that brings you together on a call.
ph_ar: بدينا مكالمة عائلية كل جمعة
ph_en: We started a weekly family video call

en: You make peace with having memories and belonging in more than one place.
ph_ar: تصالحت مع فكرة أني نتمي لأكثر من بلاصة
ph_en: I've made peace with belonging to more than one place

en: Someone visits without notice when you need rest.
ph_ar: جاوني ضيوف بلا ما يعلموا وأنا تعبان
ph_en: People keep showing up unannounced when I need rest

en: A colleague calls you outside working hours and expects an immediate reply.
ph_ar: زميلي يكلمني بعد الخدمة ويستنى رد فوري
ph_en: My colleague messages me after hours and expects an instant reply

en: Someone asks you a personal question you do not want to answer.
ph_ar: سألوني سؤال شخصي وما حبيتش نجاوب
ph_en: People keep asking me personal questions I don't want to answer

en: You agree to a request out of courtesy and then feel you cannot do it.
ph_ar: قلت إيه مجاملة وتوا ما نقدرش
ph_en: I said yes to be polite and now I can't do it

en: You need to go back on a promise you made under pressure.
ph_ar: وعدت تحت الضغط وتوا لازم نتراجع
ph_en: I made a promise under pressure and need to take it back

en: Someone takes your refusal of their request as rejecting them personally.
ph_ar: رفضت طلبه وحسبها رفض ليه هو
ph_en: He took my "no" as a personal rejection

en: You talk with someone who keeps interrupting you.
ph_ar: ديما يقطعلي الكلام
ph_en: He keeps interrupting me whenever I talk

en: One person monopolises the discussion and leaves no room for others.
ph_ar: واحد ياخذ الكلمة الكل وما يخلي حد يحكي
ph_en: One person always dominates the conversation

en: You joke with someone and then discover the joke hurt them.
ph_ar: عملت مزحة وطلعت جرحتو
ph_en: I made a joke and it really hurt him

en: You receive an apology that justifies the offence more than it admits it.
ph_ar: اعتذر بس كلامه كله تبرير
ph_en: His apology was more of an excuse than an apology

en: You need to tell someone news that will disappoint them.
ph_ar: لازمني نقولو خبر باش يخيب أملو
ph_en: I have to give someone news that will disappoint them

en: Someone asks for your advice but only wants you to back their decision.
ph_ar: يطلب نصيحتي وهو يحب نوافقو برك
ph_en: He asks for advice but only wants me to agree with him

en: You disagree with someone who raises their voice whenever you object.
ph_ar: كل ما نعارضو يعلّي صوتو علي
ph_en: He shouts at me every time I disagree

en: You try to express your anger without insulting the other person.
ph_ar: نحب نعبّر على غضبي بلا ما نهين حد
ph_en: I want to express my anger without insulting anyone

en: You discover you have said "yes" too often at the expense of your wellbeing.
ph_ar: نقول إيه للناس الكل على حساب روحي
ph_en: I say yes to everyone and I'm drained

en: A relative uses your belongings without respecting your privacy.
ph_ar: قريبي يستعمل حوايجي بلا ما يستأذن
ph_en: A relative keeps using my things without asking

en: You need to set boundaries with someone you love and depend on.
ph_ar: لازمني نحط حدود مع أمي وأنا نحبها
ph_en: I need to set boundaries with someone I love and depend on

en: You learn to listen to a complaint without rushing to offer solutions.
ph_ar: نتعلم نسمع بلا ما نعطي حلول على طول
ph_en: I'm learning to listen instead of jumping to solutions

en: You tell someone you cannot help them this time.
ph_ar: لازمني نقولو المرة هذي ما نقدرش نعاونك
ph_en: I have to tell him I can't help this time

en: You end a tense discussion and come back to it after calming down.
ph_ar: وقفت النقاش كي سخنت ونحب نرجعلو بهدوء
ph_en: I walked away from a heated argument and want to return to it calmly

en: You are added to a group you do not want to be in.
ph_ar: زادوني في مجموعة واتساب ما نحبهاش
ph_en: They added me to a WhatsApp group I don't want to be in

en: Someone posts your photo without your permission.
ph_ar: نشروا تصويرتي بلا إذني
ph_en: Someone posted my photo without my permission

en: You find an abusive comment on a personal post.
ph_ar: لقيت تعليق مسيء على البوست متاعي
ph_en: Someone left a nasty comment on my post

en: A sentence you never said is attributed to you because your words were cut out of context.
ph_ar: قصّوا كلامي ونسبولي حاجة ما قلتهاش
ph_en: They cut my words out of context and twisted what I said

en: You get a friend request from an account impersonating someone you know.
ph_ar: حساب مزيف بإسم صاحبي بعثلي طلب
ph_en: A fake account pretending to be my friend added me

en: You click a link and then suspect it was an attempt to steal your data.
ph_ar: ضغطت على رابط وخايف يكون اختراق
ph_en: I clicked a link and I'm worried it was a scam

en: You lose access to an account that holds your important files.
ph_ar: تسكّر علي الحساب وفيه ملفاتي الكل
ph_en: I'm locked out of the account with all my important files

en: A friend asks you to share your password.
ph_ar: صاحبتي تبي كلمة السر متاعي
ph_en: My friend wants my password

en: You discover your child posted your home address or phone number.
ph_ar: ولدي نشر عنوان الدار على النت
ph_en: My child posted our home address online

en: An old photo of you is used in an embarrassing context.
ph_ar: تصويرة قديمة ليا ولّت مسخرة
ph_en: An old photo of me is being used to mock me

en: A group circulates sensational news that has not been verified.
ph_ar: المجموعة تنشر في خبر ما تأكدوش منو
ph_en: My group chat is spreading news nobody has checked

en: Following other people's lives makes you more dissatisfied with your own.
ph_ar: كل ما نشوف حياة الناس في إنستغرام نكره حياتي
ph_en: Scrolling through other people's lives makes me hate mine

en: You spend a long time scrolling the news before sleep.
ph_ar: نقعد ساعات نتصفح قبل ما نرقد
ph_en: I spend hours scrolling before bed

en: You are so busy filming an event that you miss enjoying it.
ph_ar: نصور برشا وننسى نعيش اللحظة
ph_en: I'm so busy filming that I miss the moment

en: You hesitate to delete old content that no longer reflects who you are.
ph_ar: محتار نفسخ البوستات القديمة ولا لا
ph_en: I'm not sure whether to delete old posts that aren't me anymore

en: You receive a threatening message from an unknown person.
ph_ar: جاتني رسالة تهديد من واحد ما نعرفوش
ph_en: I received a threatening message from a stranger

en: You find a digital subscription renewing that you do not remember activating.
ph_ar: لقيت اشتراك يتخصم من حسابي وأنا ما فعلتوش
ph_en: I'm being charged for a subscription I don't remember signing up for

en: An online service breaks down just when you badly need it.
ph_ar: الموقع طاح في الوقت اللي محتاجو
ph_en: The website crashed right when I needed it most

en: You decide to keep away from your phone during family gatherings.
ph_ar: قررت نبعد التلفون في القعدة العائلية
ph_en: I've decided to put my phone away during family time

en: You help an elderly person protect their accounts.
ph_ar: عاونت جدي يحمي حساباتو
ph_en: I helped my grandfather secure his accounts

en: You are asked to lead a team with people more experienced than you.
ph_ar: كلفوني نقود فريق فيه ناس أقدم مني
ph_en: I'm leading a team of people more experienced than me

en: A new colleague needs training while you have urgent tasks.
ph_ar: زميل جديد يحتاج تدريب وأنا مضغوط
ph_en: I need to train a new colleague while drowning in deadlines

en: A team member is late and the group bears the consequences.
ph_ar: واحد في الفريق ديما متأخر والكل يدفع الثمن
ph_en: One team member keeps missing deadlines and we all pay for it

en: You must choose between ideas proposed by two of your friends.
ph_ar: لازمني نختار بين فكرة صاحبي وفكرة صاحبي الآخر
ph_en: I have to choose between my two friends' ideas

en: You notice a quiet person on the team never gets a chance to speak.
ph_ar: فما واحد ساكت في الفريق وما ياخذش فرصتو
ph_en: A quiet person on my team never gets a chance to speak

en: You are asked to evaluate someone you are friends with.
ph_ar: لازمني نقيّم صاحبي في الخدمة
ph_en: I have to write a performance review for my friend

en: You discover a mistake in a decision you made as the person in charge.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أن القرار اللي خذيتو كمسؤول غالط
ph_en: I made the wrong call as a manager

en: You need to admit to the team that you do not know the solution.
ph_ar: لازمني نعترف قدام الفريق أني ما نعرفش الحل
ph_en: I need to admit to my team that I don't have the answer

en: The team wants you to decide while the information is incomplete.
ph_ar: الفريق يستنى قراري والمعلومات ناقصة
ph_en: My team needs a decision and I don't have all the information

en: A team effort succeeds and the credit goes to you alone.
ph_ar: النجاح نسبوه ليا وحدي والفريق تعب معايا
ph_en: I got all the credit for something the whole team did

en: A colleague refuses to share information others need.
ph_ar: زميلي يخبي المعلومات على الفريق
ph_en: A colleague keeps information from the rest of the team

en: You hand over a task and find it hard not to interfere in every detail.
ph_ar: عطيت المهمة لغيري وما نجمتش ما نتدخلش
ph_en: I delegated a task but can't stop micromanaging

en: You notice that tasks are not distributed according to people's abilities.
ph_ar: توزيع المهام في الفريق مش عادل
ph_en: Tasks on my team aren't divided fairly

en: You receive a confidential complaint and wonder how to handle it fairly.
ph_ar: جاتني شكوى سرية وما نعرفش كيف نتصرف بعدل
ph_en: I received a confidential complaint and want to handle it fairly

en: The project scope changes after the team has started work.
ph_ar: بدلوا المشروع بعد ما بدينا
ph_en: The project changed halfway through

en: Limited resources force you to postpone part of the work.
ph_ar: الموارد ناقصة ولازم نأجل جزء
ph_en: We don't have the resources so we must delay part of the work

en: You need to explain a project delay to the client.
ph_ar: لازمني نفسر للحريف علاش تأخرنا
ph_en: I have to explain the project delay to the client

en: You resolve a conflict by letting each side explain their position.
ph_ar: حليت خلاف كي خليت كل واحد يحكي
ph_en: I resolved a conflict by letting each person be heard

en: You help a colleague succeed although they compete with you for an opportunity.
ph_ar: عاونت زميلي رغم أنه ينافسني
ph_en: I helped a colleague even though we're competing for the same promotion

en: You leave a leadership role and hand over your responsibilities to your successor.
ph_ar: سلمت منصبي للي جا بعدي
ph_en: I stepped down and handed over my role

en: The power cuts during important work you had not saved.
ph_ar: الضو قص وأنا ما سجلتش الخدمة
ph_en: The power went out and I lost unsaved work

en: Water leaks in the house as you are about to go out.
ph_ar: الماء يسيل في الدار وأنا خارج
ph_en: There's a water leak at home just as I'm leaving

en: You shut the door and discover the keys are still inside.
ph_ar: سكرت الباب والمفاتيح داخل
ph_en: I locked myself out of the house

en: The lift stops with you inside among strangers.
ph_ar: الأسانسور وقف بيا
ph_en: I'm stuck in a lift with strangers

en: A child goes missing for a few minutes in a crowded place.
ph_ar: ولدي ضاع مني في السوق
ph_en: My child went missing for a few minutes in a crowd

en: You witness an accident and need to call for help.
ph_ar: شفت حادث وما عرفت شنو نعمل
ph_en: I saw an accident and didn't know what to do

en: Someone next to you suddenly feels unwell.
ph_ar: واحد بجنبي طاح فجأة
ph_en: The person next to me suddenly collapsed

en: You must leave your home temporarily because of a fault or damage.
ph_ar: لازمنا نخرجو من الدار بسبب ضرر
ph_en: We had to leave our home because of damage

en: Transport breaks down on the day of an appointment you cannot easily postpone.
ph_ar: النقل وقف نهار الموعد المهم
ph_en: Transport broke down on the day of my important appointment

en: Hours before travelling you discover your ticket has wrong details.
ph_ar: التذكرة فيها غلطة وأنا مسافر بعد ساعات
ph_en: My ticket has the wrong details and I fly in a few hours

en: You arrive at your accommodation and the booking is not registered.
ph_ar: وصلت للأوتيل وما لقاوش الحجز
ph_en: I arrived at the hotel and they have no booking for me

en: Your suitcase is lost with clothes and medicine you need.
ph_ar: ضاعت الفاليجة وفيها الدواء
ph_en: My suitcase with my medicine got lost

en: You cannot reach a family member when you were waiting to hear from them.
ph_ar: ما نجمتش نتصل بأمي ونستنى في خبرها
ph_en: I can't reach my mother and I'm worried sick

en: You pass through an area with no phone signal and need directions.
ph_ar: ما فماش ريزو وأنا تايه
ph_en: No phone signal and I don't know the way

en: Your car stops and a stranger offers help.
ph_ar: الكرهبة وقفت وواحد غريب عاوني
ph_en: My car broke down and a stranger helped me

en: Your belongings are stolen and you must sort things out quickly.
ph_ar: سرقولي حوايجي
ph_en: My things were stolen and I have to sort everything out

en: Something you lost comes back after you thought you would never find it.
ph_ar: لقيت الحاجة اللي حسبتها ضاعت
ph_en: I found something I thought I had lost forever

en: The date of an important event changes after you arranged everything around it.
ph_ar: بدلوا الموعد بعد ما رتبت كل شي
ph_en: They changed the date after I arranged everything around it

en: You need to make a quick decision while others are panicking.
ph_ar: لازمني نقرر بسرعة والناس الكل مرتبكة
ph_en: I have to decide quickly while everyone around me panics

en: You regain your calm after a crisis and start repairing what you can.
ph_ar: بعد الأزمة نحاول نصلح اللي ينجم يتصلح
ph_en: After the crisis I'm trying to fix what can be fixed

en: You receive praise and feel you do not deserve it.
ph_ar: مدحوني وحسيت ما نستاهلش
ph_en: I got praised and felt like a fraud

en: You achieve something and then belittle it by comparing it with others'.
ph_ar: نجحت بس قلت هذا شي ما يساويش قدام غيري
ph_en: I achieved something but it feels small next to others

en: You discover that a goal you pursued was really to please others.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أني نجري ورا حلم مش متاعي
ph_en: I realised I've been chasing a goal to please other people

en: You feel embarrassed to start a new hobby late in life.
ph_ar: نحشم نبدا هواية جديدة في عمري هذا
ph_en: I feel too old to start a new hobby

en: You turn down an opportunity because you fear you are not good enough.
ph_ar: رفضت فرصة خاطر خايف ما نكونش في المستوى
ph_en: I turned down an opportunity because I felt I wasn't good enough

en: You recall an old embarrassing moment and blame yourself again and again.
ph_ar: نتفكر موقف محرج قديم ونلوم روحي
ph_en: I keep replaying an embarrassing moment from years ago

en: You discover your self-image is built on criticism you heard as a child.
ph_ar: كل اللي نحسو على روحي جاي من كلام سمعتو صغير
ph_en: My self-image comes from the criticism I heard as a child

en: You find it hard to accept help from others.
ph_ar: ما نحبش ناخذ مساعدة من حد
ph_en: I find it really hard to accept help from anyone

en: You feel you must prove your worth by constant achievement.
ph_ar: نحس لازمني ننجز ديما باش نساوي حاجة
ph_en: I feel I'm only worth something when I'm achieving

en: You have an unproductive day and learn not to treat it as failure.
ph_ar: نهار ما عملت فيه شي ونحس روحي فاشل
ph_en: I had an unproductive day and I feel like a failure
